create_ResultStat_instance: create a ResultStat instance with a batch key and optional TensorBoard log root directory
feed_ResultStat_batch: feed a batch dictionary with reward values into a ResultStat to accumulate win and loss counts
reset_ResultStat_counters: reset the win and loss counters of a ResultStat instance back to zero
log_ResultStat_winrate: log the current win rate to TensorBoard and return a formatted summary message for a given epoch
get_ResultStat_num_games: get the total number of games played by accessing the num_games property of a ResultStat instance
